literal_meaning: দিন (এই জগত) এবং দুনিয়া (পরলোক বা অন্য জগত)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জন্য দিন-দুনিয়া এক, সে কোনো কাজই করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: For him, this world and the hereafter are the same; he doesn't do any good deeds.
Think about this world and the hereafter before making a decision.
note: Often used in contexts of indifference to worldly and spiritual consequences, rooted in Islamic and broader South Asian cultural expressions.
